name: A spell's d20 rows are the roll, picked as a mode; a taken target stays in its opponent-only list — Cone of Cold, Overwhelming Encounter, Power of Persuasion, Ray of Command
notes: An instant's or sorcery's d20 table ("Roll a d20. / 1—9 | … / 10—19 | … / 20 | …") was read as plain lines (2026-11-20): every row applied whatever the roll, so Cone of Cold's 1—9 still gave the untap rule and Power of Persuasion always gained control, and a row's "1—9 |" hid its subject, so Overwhelming Encounter's +2/+2 reached nobody. The parser reads the rows as the spell's "choose one" modes (the mode keeps its range for the Modes pop-up, headed "Pick the d20 roll"; the range is dropped from what is parsed), and a line outside the table is no mode. A permanent's rows already waited for its ability to be fired (_d20Rows). Power of Persuasion's "Gain control of it" now takes the words of the one target named before it (an opponent's creature). The single picker judged "an opponent controls" by who controls the creature now, so a spell that took it (Ray of Command) dropped it from its own list; it is judged as the spell was cast.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Runeclaw Bear
scryfallData.flavor_text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Cone of Cold
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Roll a d20.
1—9 | Tap all creatures your opponents control.
10—19 | Tap all creatures your opponents control. Those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.
20 | Tap all creatures your opponents control. Those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps. Until your next turn, creatures your opponents control enter tapped.
scryfallData.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

scryfallData.name: Overwhelming Encounter
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Creatures you control gain vigilance and trample until end of turn. Roll a d20.
1—9 | Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
10—19 | Put two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
20 | Put four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
